elements.text:
Break undoes whatever holds a block together with a simple right-click.

  A weak charge only loosens soft things. The stronger the charge you spend, the harder the stone it will undo.

  Charge 1 - hardness 2, dirt, stone, cobble and planks
  Charge 2 - hardness 2.5
  Charge 3 - hardness 3, most ores and deepslate
  Charge 4 - hardness 5, iron, gold and diamond blocks
  Charge 5 - hardness 15
  Charge 6 - hardness 30, ender chests and ancient debris
  Charge 7 - hardness 50, obsidian and netherite
  Charge 8 - hardness 100
  Charge 9 - anything that can be broken at all.

  What the world holds unbreakable stays so. No charge will move bedrock.
